title: Icy Moons Are Ocean Worlds
summary: A Substack article exploring how icy moons like Europa, Enceladus, and Titan are classified as ocean worlds - celestial bodies harboring vast liquid water oceans beneath their frozen surfaces, making them prime targets in the search for extraterrestrial life.
problem_solved: Educates readers about the scientific significance of icy moons as potential habitats for life in our solar system
why_valuable: Provides accessible scientific education about planetary ocean worlds and their importance for astrobiology research
